_readme: "Life in SCG" gallery on /about/ (justified rows + lightbox). One entry per photo: file (an image under assets/), width and height in pixels (filled in by npm run build if left out), alt (what is visible; no invented events or names), order (optional; lower comes first). To add a photo: put the file in assets/photos/ and add an entry. npm run assets makes the 640px thumbnail and 1600px lightbox WebP copies. Group, event and activity photos only, never individual portraits.
